evidence.fact: VS Code distinguishes unit tests from integration tests that run in a dedicated Extension Development Host.
Attestations bind a release artifact to workflow and commit provenance; GitHub advises signing release software rather than frequent test builds.
Contract tests can use mocks for isolated fast feedback while provider verification covers the real compatibility gap.
The dispatcher rejects a missing readiness tuple before creating a worker job.
Readiness bootstrap is only recorded after a successful worker completion, creating a first-use ordering contradiction.
